beats.intent: The core problem is that CTM works with compact thought, while super-resolution must produce a dense spatial field.
beats.claim: CTM's thought representation is compact; super-resolution needs a dense spatial field.

params.headline: Compact thought must serve a dense output task.

beats.narration: The problem starts with a mismatch in shape. CTM keeps its reasoning compact, but super-resolution must predict detail across the image.

beats.intent: ThinkSR resolves the mismatch by keeping a persistent dense carrier that compact thought can read and update.
beats.claim: A persistent dense carrier, read and updated by a compact thought process.

params.headline: A dense carrier lets compact thought work on the image.

beats.narration: That carrier is the bridge between the two shapes. It keeps spatial state available while the compact process decides what to revise.

beats.intent: The carrier is created by encoding the low-resolution input, then windowing that dense feature field.

params.headline: The low-resolution image becomes windowed features.

terms.label: the encoder that forms dense features

beats.narration: The setup is explicit in the equation. The low-resolution image is encoded into dense features, and those features are split into windows.

beats.intent: End to end, ThinkSR runs encoder, windows, shared DQ-CTM ticks, and decoder as a single reconstruction path.
beats.claim: ThinkSR end to end: encoder, windows, shared DQ-CTM ticks, decoder.

params.headline: ThinkSR reconstructs through shared DQ-CTM ticks.

beats.narration: After windowing, the same DQ-CTM module is applied across ticks. The decoder then turns the updated representation into the reconstruction.

beats.intent: DQ-CTM-SR is competitive with CNN baselines but trails the recent lightweight transformer result in the benchmark table.
beats.claim: Competitive with CNN baselines; behind recent lightweight transformers.

params.headline: DQ-CTM-SR is competitive, but CATANet leads.
params.note: Params range from 0.535M to 1.592M in the table.

beats.narration: The reported averages put DQ-CTM-SR in the CNN baseline range. CATANet remains ahead, so the result is competitive but not best.
